title: OceanBench spectra insight payload
description: Payload for an insight of kind "spectra" (contracts.md §4). Power spectral density curves per variable x region x lead day: for each entry, the challenger PSD, the reference PSD, and the PSD of the challenger-minus-reference error, all sampled on a shared wavelength axis.

kind.description: Discriminator matching the manifest entry kind.

schema_version.description: Version of this payload schema (first version of this contract lineage).

entries.description: One spectrum bundle per (variable, region, lead_day).

variable.description: CF standard name of the field (contracts.md §2).

lead_day.description: 1-based lead day; spectra are precomputed for {1, 5, 10}.

reference.description: Optional reference key the reference_power/error_power are computed against (e.g. "glorys", "glo12").

unit.description: Optional physical unit of the power values.

wavelength.description: Shared wavelength axis in kilometres (descending or ascending), one value per spectral sample.

challenger_power.description: Challenger PSD sampled on the wavelength axis.

reference_power.description: Reference PSD sampled on the wavelength axis.

error_power.description: PSD of the challenger-minus-reference field, sampled on the wavelength axis.

nullableFloatArray.description: Array of floats; null encodes NaN (contracts.md §2). All four arrays in a spectrum share the same length as wavelength.
